sourceOfTruth: This file is the single machine-checkable definition of the Nano host protocol. Both the TypeScript bridge and the Rust runtime load it in tests; method tables, limits, error codes, lifecycle edges, event kinds and fixtures are compared against each implementation so neither side can drift silently.

transport.diagnostics: stdout and stderr carry diagnostics only; they never carry protocol frames. In fallback mode stdin/stdout carry protocol frames and every frame carries the per-generation nonce.

terminalAttachment.sequence: integer; last output sequence included in the snapshot
terminalAttachment.snapshot: string; bounded ANSI screen, including scrollback limits

subagentDescription.label: string?
subagentDescription.seq: integer?; next durable sequence for a local child session

paramsSemantics.bytes: declared exact source byte length; checked at finish

paramsSemantics.content: conversationSubmitContent; staged image/file blocks carry receiptId, never bytes

paramsSemantics.terminalId: Nano pre-generated; persisted before create; idempotent while open

paramsSemantics.sessionId: must equal the host root session id
paramsSemantics.terminalId: terminal to attach; omitted selects the single retained terminal

paramsSemantics.agents: direct children of the host root session in parent catalog order; no child log body is read for membership

paramsSemantics.mode: unknown catalog modes are resolved from the child's own official projection; no Agent is activated

paramsSemantics.address: child address with mode continuable; parentSessionId must own the live child
paramsSemantics.requestId: client-minted business identity persisted on the accepted message

paramsSemantics.address: child address with mode continuable; only the current turn stops

params.message: root session is owned by pid 4242
